theme: ceilings ICE-2 run meters per run
text: INTERPRETER (tree and VM): the run-wide meters behind AXON_MAX_STEPS / AXON_WALL_MS / AXON_BUDGET_TOKENS and a ceiling's steps / wall_ms / ai_tokens / ai_calls are one RunMeters per CLI invocation, installed by axon's main and shared by every interpreter that invocation builds (per-test interpreters under axon test, interpreter threads), instead of process statics. CLI behaviour is unchanged from 762bc44b; an interpreter built by a library caller outside a with_run_meters scope now gets fresh meters instead of counters left over from earlier runs in the same process, and step / ai_calls / token updates are atomic. Runs with no bound set are unchanged.
